rule: At 00:00 UTC compare yesterday's completed daily close to the preceding 14 daily closing highs (maximum of closes). At the next 01:00 open buy only after the threshold is met. After closing a position require a fresh signal: the drawdown must first recover above the entry threshold and subsequently cross below it. One spot position, all or nothing, no borrowing, new phases start flat.
trend: Yesterday close above 60-day mean, yesterday close above previous close. Filter can confirm while the pullback is still active. With 21-day cap, scheduled time exit at 01:00.
exit: A resting sell target is active starting the hour AFTER entry. Require a positive-volume hourly high beyond target by the adverse execution allowance. Credit target less adverse execution and fee. No assumed stop. Terminal horizon closes any remaining position at the 01:00 open. Base and stress use separate books.
selection: Use only the first period, rank stressed compounded weekly return among arms with >=5 completed round trips; alphabetical tiebreak. Always report all arms for all periods. Do not change rules based on the later results.
qualification: For selected strategy in EACH later period under stress require geometric weekly net >=2%, median week >=2%, drawdown <=25%, at least 5 round trips and net higher than passive and cash. Also report number of calendar weeks gaining 2%, invested-capital trade returns, waiting durations, longest hold, terminal liquidation, worst week and daily/hourly open marked drawdown. Ineligible rules stay in research.
source_fallback: If the full contiguous hourly sample is unavailable, retain completed whole Monday-to-Monday weeks covered by contiguous public candles, report lost dates and reset account after gaps; do not impute tradable prices.
